878940177241997312.en: Here is the short version of the song I supplied recently. The two members of INCUBUS wrote the melody and lyrics. It was my first time providing music for someone else, with the melody added afterward, so I was incredibly excited and nervous. Please give it a listen!

878775594443456512.en: Listening to “Yes! Party Time!!” feels exactly like listening to “GO! GO! MANIAC” seven years ago. In about a year my playlist will probably be full of Cinderella Girls songs, and I will repost this.
